summary: iter63 — Multi-device session-pending flow + 1-device=1-account dedup. Backend 6/6 pytest pass: TTL=15 min (delta 900s ±10s), 409 on cross-account device login with proper FR message including bound email, stale binding self-clearing, /devices/register lands new devices as role='inactive', Mongo $ne:'inactive' filter validated, and canonical user regression login still 200. Frontend: toast 'Ta session a expiré' fires WITHOUT codeforge_session_pending flag, and is correctly SUPPRESSED when flag is set + ?reason=session_expired is stripped from URL on visit. i18n keys (FR L447-461 + EN L1038-1052) all match spec verbatim. SessionRequestNotifier modal has the 3 required data-testids (sess-deny-modal, sess-deny-change-pwd-btn, sess-deny-later-btn). One real bug found in /api/accounts/list: it does NOT filter role='inactive' — contradicts iter63 spec item 4 and is inconsistent with /devices/list which DOES filter.

critical.issue: Does not filter out role='inactive' devices (server.py L6726 uses find({}, ...)). Spec iter63 item 4 explicitly requires inactive devices to be EXCLUDED from the creator's accounts panel. /devices/list (L4520) correctly applies {role: {$ne: 'inactive'}} — accounts/list must mirror this.

action_items: FIX server.py /api/accounts/list (L6722-6728): change `db.device_keys.find({}, ...)` to `db.device_keys.find({'role': {'$ne': 'inactive'}}, ...)` to align with /devices/list and iter63 spec item 4.
(no other functional fixes required for iter63 — backend dedup, TTL, register-inactive, toast-suppression and modal-on-deny all work as designed).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1253-1270 — 1-device-1-account check is well-placed BEFORE the multi-device approval branch; stale-binding clearing (L1270) is a nice touch and prevents lock-out after account deletion. Verified end-to-end via pytest.
server.py:1320 — TTL is computed as `now + timedelta(minutes=15)` — matches spec. Test validates the delta in the Mongo doc directly (890-910s window).
server.py:4316 — `role = 'creator' if len(distinct_ids) == 0 else 'inactive'` — correct; first device still becomes creator, all others land silent.
server.py:6722-6743 /accounts/list — MISSING the role filter. This is the only real bug. Fix is one line.
AuthContext.js:61-72 — pending-approval guard reads sessionStorage on every 401; safe and stateless. Good.
Login.js:213-225 — toast suppression on ?reason=session_expired correctly guarded by pending flag. Manually verified in browser: WITH flag → no toast; WITHOUT flag → toast shown.

SessionRequestNotifier.jsx:61-97 — denyPrompt modal correctly renders BEFORE the pending-requests modal; data-testids 'sess-deny-modal', 'sess-deny-change-pwd-btn', 'sess-deny-later-btn' all present; navigates to /profile?section=security on change-pwd. Conforms to spec.
server.py is now 7536 lines (carried from iter62) — strongly recommend splitting auth/devices/accounts into separate routers.

rca of the issue: Spec item 4 — /accounts/list filter — was missed during iter63 implementation. The dev correctly updated /devices/list at L4520 (added `{role: {$ne: 'inactive'}}`) but left /accounts/list at L6726 as `find({}, ...)`. As a result, when the creator opens the 'Autres comptes' panel, freshly-registered devices that the user has NOT yet sent via /devices/send-to-creator will still appear, defeating the silent-pending UX promised by spec item 5. Fix: change L6726 from `find({}, ...)` to `find({'role': {'$ne': 'inactive'}}, ...)`. One-liner.
